convert_linear_to_srgb: convert a linear RGB tensor or numpy array to sRGB color space using the standard gamma curve
convert_camera_to_linear: map a characterized camera color space into linear RGB using a color correction matrix and gamma
create_image_grid: arrange a batch of image tensors or a dict of labeled tensors into a grid layout for visualization
convert_tensor_to_image: convert a PyTorch tensor to a display-ready numpy image with optional jet colormap and label overlay
draw_keypoints_on_image: render keypoints with a specified color onto a given RGB numpy image using OpenCV circles
